name: Постоянные опасные зоны воздушного пространства Российской Федерации

metadata.geometry_source_notice: The current fpln.ru danger-area tile response exposes only currently returned map objects. Missing permanent danger areas were constructed from Mintrans Order No. 171. ULD32 and ULD33 contain approximated state-border segments. Operational use requires aeronautical verification and current NOTAM checks.
